scope: s 7 (the contribution duty), s 15(1)-(6) (withdrawal), s 16 (the medisave restrictions) and s 25(1) (who may nominate, and how a large nomination is split), with the s 2 definition of 'applicable person'. STILL A SMALL FRACTION of an Act of about 911,000 characters. ADDED 11 Oct 2026 for REQ-0001 and REQ-0012: First Schedule paragraphs 1 and 7 (contribution rates from 1 January 2026 for citizens and second-year-plus permanent residents, ordinary wages only, the Ordinary Wage Ceiling and rounding), s 24(3A) (moneys on death outside the estate) and s 25(5) (nomination revoked by marriage). NOT ENCODED: additional wages, the graduated permanent-resident rates, s 13 (crediting into the three accounts), s 15AA, s 15(4), the housing and investment charges, the rest of s 25 and s 25A, and everything from Part 3A onwards. The prescribed retirement sum, the contribution rates and the Minister's maximum nomination amount are facts supplied; the regulations were not retrieved.
